blocks.html: Robinsons Malls once again collaborates with Colegio de San Juan de Letran for their 2nd Entrep Corner as it launches “Negosyo Letranista” where students showcase their skills as entrepreneurs and present various products handcrafted by the students themselves. From September 11 to 15, a staggering 84 student companies will join this week-long activity at Robinsons Place Manila where shoppers and foodies will enjoy visiting the different booths as they indulge in some exciting shopping. A wide variety of goods await the shoppers as they fill their bags with stylish apparels and accessories and delight their palates with delicious treats and drinks. Through the Robinsons Malls Entrep Corner, graduating students taking up business-related courses will be able to develop and hone their entrepreneurial and marketing skills. This project will also be the platform for the students to showcase their innovative business ideas through a holistic retail experience in a Robinsons Mall.
